originalPathPolicy: Original report absolute paths are intentionally unchanged historical production references. The source -> archive entries relocate selected evidence; do not edit original report bytes to make paths portable.
restoreGzip: gzip.decompress(archive bytes) must equal originalBytes/originalSha256. Identity files must match directly.
excluded: Full media/audio/reference videos and machine maintenance logs are not distributed. Absolute historical media references intentionally point outside this compact evidence set.

sourceFingerprints.scope: Post-edit source is not substituted for historical capture sources. Some base chunks explicitly retain a historical pre-mux capture provenance and a checked container-only resume alias.
